|work=mint |date=15 December 2022 |language=en}} ==History== Indegene was founded in 1998 by Dr. Rajesh Nair, Manish Gupta, Gaurav Kapoor, Dr.Sanjay Parikh and Anand Kiran.{{cite news | last=Amirapu| first=Deepika| title =Indegene eyes US call centre buy for $10–15 million| newspaper =[[The Economic Times]]| date =9 March 2012 | url =http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2012-03-09/news/31139486_1_indegene-lifesystems-marketing-medical-education| archive-url =https://web.archive.org/web/20151119075559/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2012-03-09/news/31139486_1_indegene-lifesystems-marketing-medical-education| url-status =dead| archive-date =19 November 2015| access-date =2 October 2015}} Indegene's first acquisition was Medsn, a company that provided medical education. Medsn continued to operate under the same name in the United States.{{cite news | last=D'Silva| first=Jeetha| title =Indegene acquires US medical education co| newspaper =[[The Economic Times]]| date =17 September 2005 | url =http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2005-09-17/news/27506888_1_equity-firm-ge-equity-subsidiary| archive-url =https://web.archive.org/web/20151016233025/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2005-09-17/news/27506888_1_equity-firm-ge-equity-subsidiary| url-status =dead| archive-date =16 October 2015| access-date =2 October 2015}} In 2008, Medsn officially became Indegene Pharmaceutical Solutions in the United States. In 2006, Indegene acquired MedCases, a [[continuing medical education]] company based in the United States. In 2009, Indegene signed a [[master service agreement]] with six pharmaceutical companies.{{cite news| title =Indegene highlights benefits of patient adherence programs for pharma cos| publisher =PharmaBiz| date =3 June 2011| url =http://pharmabiz.com/NewsDetails.aspx?aid=63241&sid=2| access-date =2 October 2015| archive-date =19 November 2015| archive-url =https://web.archive.org/web/20151119144237/http://pharmabiz.com/NewsDetails.aspx?aid=63241&sid=2| url-status =dead}} The following year, Indegene acquired [[Canada]]-based Aptilon, a [[multichannel marketing]] firm, for $4 million.{{cite news | last=Mukherjee| first=Rupali| title =Indegene to acquire Canada-based company for $4 million | newspaper =[[Times of India]]| date =7 November 2012 | url =http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/Indegene-to-acquire-Canada-based-company-for-4-million/articleshow/17133296.cms| access-date =2 October 2015}} The company subsequently acquired [[Atlanta]]-based Total Therapeutic Management in 2014.{{cite news | last=Craig| first=Tara| title =Indegene acquires Total Therapeutic Management | publisher =PMLive.com| date =9 January 2014 | url =http://www.pmlive.com/pharma_news/indegene_acquires_total_therapeutic_management_532004| access-date =2 October 2015}} In September 2019, Indegene acquired London-based consulting company, DT Associates, for $10 million.{{cite news |last1=Balakrishnan |first1=Reghu |title=Healthcare tech firm Indegene acquires DT Associates |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/healthcare/biotech/healthcare/healthcare-tech-firm-indegene-acquires-dt-associates/articleshow/70960667.cms |access-date=28 April 2024 |work=The Economic Times |date=3 September 2019}} In February 2021, [[the Carlyle Group]] and Brighton Park Capital invested $200 million in Indegene.{{cite news | last=Madhurima| first=Nandy| title =Indegene to raise $200 mn from Carlyle, Brighton Park| newspaper =[[LiveMint]]| date =3 February 2021 | url =https://www.livemint.com/companies/start-ups/indegene-to-raise-200-mn-from-carlyle-brighton-park-11612286897793.html| access-date =20 August 2021}} In August 2021, Indegene acquired Medical Marketing Economics (MME), an American [[market access]] and [[pricing science|pricing strategy]] company, for $10 million.{{cite news |last1=Baruah |first1=Ayushman |title=Indegene acquires US-based Medical Marketing Economics for $10 mn |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/indegene-acquires-us-based-medical-marketing-economics-for-10-mn-11630322193354.html |access-date=28 April 2024 |work=Mint |date=30 August 2021 |language=en}} Indegene went [[Public company|public]] in May 2024 with an [[initial public offering]], raising {{INRconvert|1842|c}}. It listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] and the [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]].{{cite news |last1=Narayanan |first1=KS Badri |title=Indegene IPO opens today in ₹430-452 price band |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/ipo-screener-indegene-issue-opens-today-in-430-452-price-band/article68143174.ece |access-date=6 May 2024 |work=BusinessLine |date=6 May 2024 |language=en}}{{cite news |title=PE firms Carlyle, Nadathur Fareast, Brighton Park Capital-backed Indegene IPO to open on May 6 |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/ipo/pe-firms-carlyle-nadathur-fareast-brighton-park-capital-backed-indegene-ipo-to-open-on-may-6-12709591.html |access-date=28 April 2024 |work=Moneycontrol}} ==Operations== Indegene has offices in India, the United States, the [[European Union]], and [[Asia-Pacific]].{{cite news| last =Vijay| first =Nandita| title =Indegene plans next phase of growth through acquisition in US, EU markets| publisher =PharmaBiz| date =7 November 2012| url =http://pharmabiz.com/NewsDetails.aspx?aid=72031&sid=1| access-date =2 October 2015| extract: Indegene Limited is an Indian company that provides research and commercialization services to biopharmaceutical and healthcare enterprises. Based in Bangalore, the company provides consulting in pharmaceutical marketing, clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, medical and regulatory affairs, and health informatics.
